name: How long does a typical floor plan redesign project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical floor plan redesign project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a floor plan redesign project varies significantly based on complexity and scope. Minor changes might take a few weeks for design and construction, while extensive structural modifications could extend to several months. Factors like permit acquisition, material availability, and the homeowner's decision-making timeline also influence the schedule. Simply Construction provides a detailed project timeline after the initial consultation and design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies. Minor changes take weeks; extensive structural modifications can take months. Factors include permits, materials, and decision-making.
